items.briefing:
Home batteries and solar systems connected to the internet are now being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern for Australian organisations — if these devices are on your network, they may need to be assessed under your security policies. Separately, Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger defences against scams, reflecting ongoing pressure on Australian businesses and individuals to stay vigilant against fraud attempts.

**Practical tip:** If your workplace has smart energy devices like batteries or solar inverters connected to the office network, raise this with your IT team to ensure they're included in your security reviews.

featured.title: Australia's home batteries are now a cybersecurity compliance isue
featured.summary: Millions of rooftop batteries are now subject to mandatory cyber standards as Canberra widens scrutiny of grid-connected home devices.
